question.text: Pre-cleared trades by designated persons under the PIT Code of Conduct must be executed within:

answer.text: 7 trading days of approval, failing which fresh pre-clearance is needed

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.21, pre-cleared trades must be executed within 7 trading days of approval; else fresh pre-clearance is required. The Trap: 2/5/15 days are incorrect windows. Cross-Exam Context: Same 7-day rule applies to listed-company employee PIT codes. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Calendar the 7-day window in the pre-clearance tool to auto-trigger renewal if the window lapses.
